title: Driven out of forests, 56 displaced elephants run into politics in Karnataka

ai.summary: Karnataka's forest department suspended moving 56 displaced elephants from coffee estates to Bhadra forests after protests by local legislators and residents in Chikkamagaluru, with elephants scattered across three districts.

facts.claim: Karnataka’s plan to move 56 elephants from Hassan’s coffee estates to Bhadra has stalled after protests by legislators and residents in Chikkamagaluru
facts.quote: Karnataka’s plan to move 56 elephants from Hassan’s coffee estates to Bhadra has stalled after protests by legislators and residents in Chikkamagaluru.

facts.claim: The movement of 56 elephants out of Hassan’s coffee estates in Karnataka has run into a political roadblock, with the forest department temporarily suspending the operation after protests by legislators and residents in neighbouring Chikkamagaluru
facts.quote: The movement of 56 elephants out of Hassan’s coffee estates in Karnataka has run into a political roadblock, with the forest department temporarily suspending the operation after protests by legislators and residents in neighbouring Chikkamagaluru.

facts.claim: The herd, meanwhile, has scattered across three districts, with 39 elephants in Mudigere, 13 back in Belur and four tuskers moving towards Kodagu as of November 26
facts.quote: The herd, meanwhile, has scattered across three districts, with 39 elephants in Mudigere, 13 back in Belur and four tuskers moving towards Kodagu as of November 26.

facts.claim: The operation, launched after two people were killed in elephant attacks in Belur, began on November 21, following the capture of two tuskers on November 18 and 19
facts.quote: The operation, launched after two people were killed in elephant attacks in Belur, began on November 21, following the capture of two tuskers on November 18 and 19.

facts.claim: One was shifted to the Mathigodu elephant camp in Nagarahole Tiger Reserve, while the other was released into the wild in Bandipur after being fitted with a radio collar
facts.quote: One was shifted to the Mathigodu elephant camp in Nagarahole Tiger Reserve, while the other was released into the wild in Bandipur after being fitted with a radio collar.

facts.claim: The forest department then began guiding the remaining 56 elephants from Belur towards the Bhadra forests
facts.quote: The forest department then began guiding the remaining 56 elephants from Belur towards the Bhadra forests.

facts.claim: Although the operation has been suspended, officials are continuing to monitor the herd and guide the elephants in Mudigere towards the Tatakola forest area, which adjoins reserve forests
facts.quote: Although the operation has been suspended, officials are continuing to monitor the herd and guide the elephants in Mudigere towards the Tatakola forest area, which adjoins reserve forests.

facts.claim: Forest minister Ramalinga Reddy is scheduled to meet legislators from the affected districts on November 30 to discuss the issue
facts.quote: Forest minister Ramalinga Reddy is scheduled to meet legislators from the affected districts on November 30 to discuss the issue.

facts.claim: Hassan district in-charge minister K M Shivalinge Gowda has defended the operation, arguing that Belur has barely 100 acres of forest and cannot provide adequate habitat for the elephants
facts.quote: Hassan district in-charge minister K M Shivalinge Gowda has defended the operation, arguing that Belur has barely 100 acres of forest and cannot provide adequate habitat for the elephants.

facts.claim: However, Congress MLAs Nayana Motamma, T D Rajegowda and H D Thammaiah have opposed moving the herd towards Chikkamagaluru, which also faces frequent human-elephant conflict
facts.quote: However, Congress MLAs Nayana Motamma, T D Rajegowda and H D Thammaiah have opposed moving the herd towards Chikkamagaluru, which also faces frequent human-elephant conflict.

facts.claim: Motamma, who represents Mudigere, submitted her resignation to the Assembly speaker on November 23, protesting against the movement of elephants into her constituency without consulting local elected representatives
facts.quote: Motamma, who represents Mudigere, submitted her resignation to the Assembly speaker on November 23, protesting against the movement of elephants into her constituency without consulting local elected representatives.

facts.claim: She withdrew it after chief minister D K Shivakumar and senior Congress leaders intervened, but continued to demand assurances on public safety
facts.quote: She withdrew it after chief minister D K Shivakumar and senior Congress leaders intervened, but continued to demand assurances on public safety.

facts.claim: I have to answer the people who elected me. I am not answerable merely to the government. If we cannot protect the people who elected us, what is the purpose of holding public office?
facts.quote: I have to answer the people who elected me. I am not answerable merely to the government. If we cannot protect the people who elected us, what is the purpose of holding public office?

facts.claim: Reddy, meanwhile, said elephants belonged in forests rather than coffee estates and cautioned legislators against politicising the issue
facts.quote: Reddy, meanwhile, said elephants belonged in forests rather than coffee estates and cautioned legislators against politicising the issue.

facts.claim: These elephants belong to the forest and not to the coffee estates. Do not indulge in politics
facts.quote: These elephants belong to the forest and not to the coffee estates. Do not indulge in politics

ai.background_note: Elephant displacement in Karnataka has led to political resistance as communities fear inheriting human-elephant conflict, with forest officials and legislators debating habitat fragmentation and safe relocation.
